title: Detailed umbrella
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- umbrella canopy - scalloped dome shape -->
  <path d="M10 50 Q15 20 50 15 Q85 20 90 50 Z" fill="#e63946" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- canopy scallop segments -->
  <path d="M10 50 Q20 42 25 50 Q30 42 37 50 Q43 42 50 50 Q57 42 63 50 Q70 42 75 50 Q80 42 90 50 Z" fill="#c1121f" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- lighter scallop tips for definition -->
  <path d="M10 50 Q17 44 25 50" fill="#ff6b6b" stroke="none" opacity="0.6"/>
  <path d="M25 50 Q31 44 37 50" fill="#ff6b6b" stroke="none" opacity="0.6"/>
  <path d="M37 50 Q43 44 50 50" fill="#ff6b6b" stroke="none" opacity="0.6"/>
  <path d="M50 50 Q57 44 63 50" fill="#ff6b6b" stroke="none" opacity="0.6"/>
  <path d="M63 50 Q69 44 75 50" fill="#ff6b6b" stroke="none" opacity="0.6"/>
  <path d="M75 50 Q82 44 90 50" fill="#ff6b6b" stroke="none" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- rib lines -->
  <line x1="50" y1="16" x2="25" y2="49" stroke="#ffb3b3" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="16" x2="37" y2="49" stroke="#ffb3b3" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="16" x2="50" y2="49" stroke="#ffb3b3" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="16" x2="63" y2="49" stroke="#ffb3b3" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="16" x2="75" y2="49" stroke="#ffb3b3" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- top finial -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="14" r="3" fill="#ffd166" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- shaft -->
  <rect x="48.5" y="50" width="3" height="35" rx="1" fill="#8d6e63" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- shaft highlight -->
  <rect x="49" y="50" width="1" height="35" rx="0.5" fill="#a1887f" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- curved handle -->
  <path d="M50 85 Q50 95 40 95 Q30 95 30 86" fill="none" stroke="#8d6e63" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 85 Q50 95 40 95 Q30 95 30 86" fill="none" stroke="#a1887f" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- handle tip -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="85" r="2.5" fill="#ffd166" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- inner canopy warmth -->
  <path d="M18 48 Q30 28 50 24 Q70 28 82 48 Z" fill="#ff8fa3" stroke="none" opacity="0.3"/>
</svg>
